paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles with H.E.S.S. from the irregularity of the PKS 2155-304 energy spectrum
notes: H.E.S.S. constraint on ALP-photon coupling from spectral irregularity of PKS 2155-304 (z=0.116). Conservative limit g_gamma-a < 2.1e-11 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L. for ALP masses 15-60 neV, based on photon-ALP mixing in the galaxy cluster magnetic field (conservative 1 uG assumption); encoded as a flat bound over the stated validity range. The paper also reports an optimistic IGMF-based limit of ~5e-11 GeV^-1 near m~1 neV (1 nG field assumption), not included here since it is explicitly labeled optimistic. Full exclusion contours are only in Fig. 7 (not tabulated). Astrophysical bound, no local DM density assumption.
